headlines.title: JPMorgan Asset Management sees Bitcoin beating stocks, but with a big catch
headlines.description: JPMorgan Asset Management has introduced Bitcoin into its long-term capital market assumptions for the first time. The firm forecasts annualized returns of 10% over the next decade, alongside significant volatility of 55%. This volatility may undermine Bitcoin's attractiveness on a risk-adjusted basis compared to traditional investments. Despite the potential returns, JPMorgan has not incorporated Bitcoin into its main portfolio models due to instability.
